texts.arguments: 2 . Mr. Giri, learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is falsely implicated in the present matter. The applicant has n criminal antecedents. The Contraband Ganja is already seized from the car and the vehicle was also seized and handed over to the owner of the vehicle on Supurtnama in the proceeding filed by the owner of the vehicle. Thus, nothing remains to be recovered at the instance of the applicant. As such, he may be released on bail. He is not having any criminal antecedents against him. He is also ready to abide by any conditions that may be imposed by this Court. Learned APP Mr. Khan vehemently opposes the application on the ground that huge contraband of prohibited tobacco and Pan masala has been seized after receiving the secret information. The applicant was asked to accompany to the police station, however, ran away by leaving the vehicle on the spot.
